task: Fulfill 5-item operational checklist across proposal gating, archived project direct reading, plagiarism vs similarity terminology, flagged proposal submission, and per-session submission lists with visual proof across light and dark modes

requirements_fulfilled.requirement: Results should be seen only once details are filled in
requirements_fulfilled.implementation: Gated similarity analysis tab and clearance meters behind hasDetailsFilled (>= 10 chars title, >= 20 chars description, or >= 10 chars problemStatement). Displays similarity-awaiting-details prompt card and Awaiting Details badge when empty.

requirements_fulfilled.requirement: User should be able to read the full paper if project is archived, details should not be visible (direct to whole paper)
requirements_fulfilled.implementation: ProjectDetailPage and MyProjectPage route archived projects directly to CanonicalDocumentViewer and /archive/document/:id, hiding administrative drafting tabs, steppers, and review cards.

requirements_fulfilled.requirement: Tabs: plagiarism vs similarity should be definite
requirements_fulfilled.implementation: Active capstone submissions strictly use 'Plagiarism' / 'Plagiarism Matches'; archive document reader strictly uses 'Similarity' / 'Similarity Matches' and '12% Similarity' score.

requirements_fulfilled.requirement: Proposal should be able to be submitted, but should be flagged
requirements_fulfilled.implementation: Eliminated 409 conflict throwing on high title similarity. Displays amber alert banner 'Proposal Flagged for Similarity Scrutiny' with 'Similarity Flagged' badge. Submit button is unlocked and sends isFlagged: true, flagReason, and similarityScore.
ChapterReviewPanel connects selectedSession filter ('all', 's1', 's2') to displayItems filtering, grouping initial rounds vs revisions per session.
